CITY OF LA VERNE

  ADJOURNED MEETING

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

 Tim Hepburn, Mayor  www.cityoflaverne.org
  (909) 596-8726 - Phone
 Robin Carder, Mayor Pro Tem
  (909) 596-8740 - Fax
 Muir Davis, Council Member
  City Hall Council Chamber
 Rick Crosby, Council Member
  3660 D Street
 Wendy M. Lau, Council Member  La Verne, CA 91750

  Wednesday, September 09, 2020 - 4 pm

This afternoon’s meeting is closed to the public pursuant to the Brown Act.

Regular City Council Meetings are scheduled on the 1st and 3rd Mondays of every month at 6:30 pm.

1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL: Council Member Lau, Council Member Crosby, Council Member Davis, Mayor
  Pro Tem Carder and Mayor Hepburn.

3.  CLOSED SESSION

  The City Council will meet in a closed session pursuant to Government Code Section 54957 for the
  following:

   Public Employee Performance Evaluation - City Manager.

4.  ADJOURNMENT

  THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING of the La Verne City Council is
  scheduled for Monday, September 21, 2020 at 6:30 p.m.

  The La Verne City Council thanks the community
  for taking all the precautions to prevent the spread of COVID-19.

  Posting Statement: On September 9, 2020, a true and correct copy of this Agenda was posted on the bulletin
  board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at cityoflaverne.org.
